implementation.core_integration: LaplaceCore exposes an injectable/lazy logical_subagents scheduler and run_logical_subagents adapter.
properties: Logical children are typed, owner/project scoped, bounded by queue width and spawn depth, and restricted to declared local read/verification/proposal capabilities.

The default mode is SERIAL with one GPU execution slot. QUEUED_LOGICAL preserves FIFO order while keeping actual GPU execution serial. REAL_CONCURRENT is rejected unless an explicit policy enables it with a GPU concurrency limit of at least two.

GPU admission requires an injected AVAILABLE observation and sufficient free MiB; unavailable or uncertain ownership fails closed. NVIDIA VRAM is treated as a separate resource and no memory-pool union is asserted.

Cooperative cancellation covers queued and running children; executor cancellation signals are propagated, queued cancellation does not execute the callable, and owner checks prevent cross-user cancellation.
Executor OOM is reported as RECOVERABLE and releases the slot so subsequent queued work can proceed. Other executor failures are typed FAILED; no automatic retry or hidden replay exists.

Queue outcomes preserve input order and expose queue position, observed queue wait, elapsed time, GPU observation and failure category. These observations are evidence fields, not unmeasured production claims.
security_boundaries: The scheduler has no subprocess, shell, network, dynamic import or model-response execution path; model work is supplied only by the caller's cooperative executor.
Tasks cannot increase authority, spawn depth, GPU slots or concurrency through goal/context text. Real concurrency is a constructor policy decision and is not enabled by default.

A scheduler close signals queued/running work and never forcibly kills arbitrary processes. Durable whole-agent queue/restart ownership remains in the repaired production AgentTaskScheduler; logical callable state is intentionally not replayed after a scheduler restart.
No model backend, serving profile, CodeV route, production routing policy or source checkout was changed.
